components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink block with accent fill rising from the bottom on hover or focus.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; background: #0c0c0d; color: #f1f3f4; text-decoration: none; font: 700 0.95rem/1 'Anybody Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-stretch: 110%; letter-spacing: 0.03em; position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: #00b8d9; transform: translateY(101%); transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); z-index: -1; } .ds-btn:hover, .ds-btn:focus-visible { color: #0c0c0d; } .ds-btn:hover::before, .ds-btn:focus-visible::before { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0c0c0d; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #00b8d9; }

components.name: Underlined Link
components.description: Secondary action in Anybody with a 2px underline that turns accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-link { color: #0c0c0d; font: 700 0.95rem/1 'Anybody Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-stretch: 110%; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 0.4em; padding: 0.9rem 0; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-color: #00b8d9; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0c0c0d; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #00b8d9; }

components.name: Accent Swatches and Language Toggle
components.description: Top-bar controls: three round accent swatches (selected gets an outer ring) and an ES/EN toggle.
components.css: .ds-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-sw { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; min-width: 1.25rem; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid #0c0c0d; position: relative; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; } .ds-sw-cyan { background: #00b8d9; } .ds-sw-magenta { background: #ea1e7d; } .ds-sw-yellow { background: #ffd400; } .ds-sw[aria-pressed='true']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -5px; border: 1px solid #0c0c0d; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-langs { display: flex; gap: 0.15rem; margin-left: 1rem; font: 700 0.8125rem/1 'Anybody Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-stretch: 110%; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-langs button { padding: 0.5rem 0.55rem; min-height: 2.25rem; background: none; border: 0; color: #0c0c0d; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-langs button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #0c0c0d; color: #f1f3f4; }

components.name: Project Row
components.description: Ruled list row: title widens on hover, accent stripe motif drifts in, arrow nudges.
components.html: portfolioShort description of the repo.Astro · TS
components.css: .ds-row { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1.5fr) minmax(0,1fr) 9rem 28px; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.4rem 0; border-top: 1px solid #0c0c0d; border-bottom: 1px solid #0c0c0d; color: #0c0c0d; text-decoration: none; overflow: hidden; } .ds-row-title { position: relative; z-index: 1; font: 800 2.2rem/1 'Anybody Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 64, 'wght' 760; transition: font-variation-settings 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-row-desc { position: relative; z-index: 1; color: #464a4f; max-width: 40ch; font: 400 1.0625rem/1.55 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row-tags { position: relative; z-index: 1; text-align: right; font: 600 0.8125rem/1.2 'Anybody Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-stretch: 105%; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-row-arrow { position: relative; z-index: 1; transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-row-motif { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 0 auto; width: 38%; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #00b8d9 0 3px, transparent 3px 7px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #0c0c0d 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px); background-size: 14px 100%, 7px 100%; -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 40%); mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 40%); transition: opacity 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-title, .ds-row:focus-visible .ds-row-title { font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 128, 'wght' 800; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-motif, .ds-row:focus-visible .ds-row-motif { opacity: 1; animation: ds-drift 2.4s linear infinite; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-arrow, .ds-row:focus-visible .ds-row-arrow { transform: translate(4px, -4px); } @keyframes ds-drift { to { background-position: 14px 0, 7px 0; } } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0c0c0d; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #00b8d9; }

components.name: Stack Term Group
components.description: Label column plus large width-axis terms that widen and underline in accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-group { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(7rem,14rem) 1fr; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.25rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(12,12,13,0.16); align-items: baseline; color: #0c0c0d; } .ds-group-label { font: 700 0.8125rem/1.2 'Anybody Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-stretch: 105%; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-terms { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.2em 1.4rem; } .ds-term { font: 800 2.2rem/1.1 'Anybody Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 70, 'wght' 700; transition: font-variation-settings 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); cursor: default; } .ds-term:hover { font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 130, 'wght' 800; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #00b8d9; text-decoration-thickness: 0.12em; text-underline-offset: 0.12em; }

components.name: Line Field Strip
components.description: Static CSS approximation of the canvas signature: 1px vertical ink lines with an accent band layer under a radial mask. The shipped version is two canvases bent by the pointer.
components.css: .ds-field { position: relative; height: 7rem; background: #f1f3f4; overflow: hidden; } .ds-field-color, .ds-field-ink { position: absolute; inset: 0; } .ds-field-color { background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #00b8d9 0 3px, transparent 3px 18px); -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 30% 70% at 50% 50%, #000 25%, transparent 80%); mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 30% 70% at 50% 50%, #000 25%, transparent 80%); } .ds-field-ink { background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #0c0c0d 0 1px, transparent 1px 9px); }

narrative.overview:
A cool white page that is mostly empty, so the few things on it can move. The ground is a field of 1px vertical lines (Soto / Cruz-Diez, Venezuelan kinetic art) that bend around the visitor's pointer, with a strip of the current accent shifting behind them. The name is set in a variable face whose width axis opens near the cursor. Everything else is ink on paper, ruled by hairlines.

The system is sober by omission: one chromatic accent at a time, no radius on structure, no shadow, no imagery, no icons beyond one arrow. Density is low; type size carries hierarchy, not weight of decoration. Motion is the personality, and it is always tied to the pointer or to hover.
keyCharacteristics: Ink (#0c0c0d) on cool paper (#f1f3f4); the accent is the only chroma on the page.
Width-axis display type (Anybody) used at enormous and mid sizes; Hanken Grotesk for reading text.
1px vertical lines are the only ornament; rules and borders are 1px ink.
Flat, square, shadowless; depth comes from the canvas field and a mask-revealed color strip.
Bilingual ES/EN by paired spans; layout never depends on which language shows.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Exactly one accent is live at a time; the other two exist only as swatches in the top bar. Never show two accents together or add a fourth hue.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Yellow Rule
rules.body: Text that sits on the accent is always ink, and when yellow is live, underline hovers switch to ink so they stay legible. Never place accent-colored text on Cool Paper.

rules.name: The Width Is The Motion Rule
rules.body: Display type animates through font-variation-settings (wdth, wght), never through scale or position shifts. Transitions run 0.5 to 0.6s on --ease.

rules.name: The Reading Text Rule
rules.body: Anything longer than a line is Hanken, never Anybody.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. State changes use color fill, width-axis change, or a 4px arrow nudge, not shadow.

dos: Do keep exactly one accent live and drive it through --accent / data-accent.
Do put all ornament in 1px vertical lines and 1px ink rules.
Do animate display type through wdth and wght, honoring prefers-reduced-motion by freezing to the settled state.
Do keep every string as a paired ES/EN span and make layouts work with either.
Do keep content visible by default; reveal animation applies only when JS is on and motion is welcome.
donts: Don't use a dark bento grid, card wall, or tech-stack icon wall.
Don't add radius, drop shadows, gradients as fills, or imagery.
Don't set body-length text in Anybody or accent-colored text on Cool Paper.
Don't introduce a second ornament motif beside the vertical lines.
